display.purpose: The masthead title uses a single italic word.

headline.purpose: Opponent selection, scorecard and rules headings.

action.purpose: Labels on New round and Undo move.

shadows.name: Table frame
shadows.purpose: A shallow shadow under the playing table.

motion.name: Mark placement
motion.purpose: A mark settles from 4px above its cell at 1.08 scale and 0.45 opacity. Reduced-motion preference suppresses the animation.

components.name: New round
components.description: The wider action below the board starts a fresh round.
components.html: <button class="ds-primary" type="button"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="1.1rem" height="1.1rem" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M3 12a9 9 0 1 0 9-9 9.75 9.75 0 0 0-6.74 2.74L3 8"/><path d="M3 3v5h5"/></svg>New round</button>
components.css: .ds-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 9px; min-height: 44px; border-radius: 8px; color: var(--ink,#183d31); font: 700 .9rem/1.45 var(--sans,'DM Sans Variable',system-ui,sans-serif); cursor: pointer; } .ds-primary { border: 0; background: var(--lime,#d8ed82); } .ds-primary:hover { background: #cbe36c; } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #996515; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Undo move
components.description: The secondary round action has a thin outline and a disabled state.
components.html: <button class="ds-secondary" type="button"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="1.1rem" height="1.1rem" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M9 14 4 9l5-5"/><path d="M4 9h10.5a5.5 5.5 0 0 1 5.5 5.5a5.5 5.5 0 0 1-5.5 5.5H11"/></svg>Undo move</button>
components.css: .ds-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 9px; min-height: 44px; border-radius: 8px; color: var(--ink,#183d31); font: 700 .9rem/1.45 var(--sans,'DM Sans Variable',system-ui,sans-serif); cursor: pointer; } .ds-secondary { border: 1px solid #aeb9a7; background: transparent; } .ds-secondary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #eaeddf; } .ds-secondary:disabled { color: #747d71; border-color: var(--line,#d4d8c8); cursor: default; } .ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #996515; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Reset scores
components.description: A compact action sits beside the scorecard heading.
components.html: <button type="button" class="ds-reset"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="1.1rem" height="1.1rem" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M3 12a9 9 0 1 0 9-9 9.75 9.75 0 0 0-6.74 2.74L3 8"/><path d="M3 3v5h5"/></svg>Reset scores</button>
components.css: .ds-reset { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; min-height: 40px; padding: 5px 8px; background: transparent; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; color: var(--muted,#58675c); font: 600 .77rem/1.45 var(--sans,'DM Sans Variable',system-ui,sans-serif); } .ds-reset svg { width: 13px; } .ds-reset:hover { background: #e9ecdf; } .ds-reset:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #996515; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Game tools
components.description: A fine vertical rule separates sound from the rules dialog.
components.css: .ds-tools { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; } .ds-tools button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; min-height: 40px; padding: 5px 8px; background: transparent; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; color: var(--ink,#183d31); font: 600 .85rem/1.45 var(--sans,'DM Sans Variable',system-ui,sans-serif); } .ds-tools i { height: 15px; width: 1px; background: var(--line,#d4d8c8); } .ds-tools button:hover { background: #e9ecdf; } .ds-tools button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #996515; outline-offset: 3px; } @media(max-width:430px) { .ds-tools { gap: 3px; } .ds-tools button { font-size: .8rem; } .ds-tools button:first-child { min-width: 40px; justify-content: center; } .ds-tools button span { display: none; } }

components.name: Opponent choice
components.description: The entire row selects the opponent. The portrait, description and radio share a single label.
components.css: .ds-opponent { display: flex; box-sizing: border-box; position: relative; align-items: center; gap: 13px; min-height: 61px; padding: 9px 14px 9px 10px; background: #fdfcf5; color: var(--ink,#183d31); border: 1px solid var(--line,#d4d8c8); border-radius: 10px; font: 400 .79rem/1.45 var(--sans,'DM Sans Variable',system-ui,sans-serif); cursor: pointer; } .ds-opponent input { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; opacity: 0; } .ds-avatar { display: grid; flex: none; place-items: center; width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 8px; background: #e0e7c6; color: #425d43; } .ds-copy { display: grid; gap: 1px; color: var(--muted,#58675c); } .ds-copy strong { color: var(--ink,#183d31); font-size: .96rem; font-weight: 720; } .ds-opponent i { box-sizing: border-box; width: 16px; height: 16px; margin-left: auto; border: 1px solid #9aa38e; border-radius: 50%; } .ds-opponent:hover { border-color: #8c9d85; } .ds-opponent:has(input:checked) { background: #e9efd6; border-color: #809461; } .ds-opponent input:checked ~ i { border: 5px solid var(--green,#204f3f); background: var(--paper,#f8f7ef); } .ds-opponent:has(input:focus-visible) { outline: 3px solid #996515; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Playing grid
components.description: A static example of the square grid, center pips and two piece silhouettes.
components.css: .ds-felt { display: grid; place-items: center; padding: 24px 22px; border-radius: 8px; background: radial-gradient(#c2d2a51f .8px,transparent 1px) 0 0 / 5px 5px, var(--green,#204f3f); } .ds-board { display: grid; width: min(100%,318px); aspect-ratio: 1; grid-template: repeat(3,1fr) / repeat(3,1fr); border: 1px solid #92ae96; border-radius: 3px; } .ds-board span { display: grid; place-items: center; } .ds-board span:nth-child(n+4) { border-top: 2px solid #99b39c; } .ds-board span:not(:nth-child(3n+1)) { border-left: 2px solid #99b39c; } .ds-pip { width: 3px; height: 3px; border-radius: 50%; background: #94ad8f; } .ds-cross,.ds-ring { box-sizing: border-box; width: 1em; height: 1em; font-size: clamp(42px,5vw,58px); } .ds-cross { background: var(--lime,#d8ed82); clip-path: polygon(18% 0,50% 32%,82% 0,100% 18%,68% 50%,100% 82%,82% 100%,50% 68%,18% 100%,0 82%,32% 50%,0 18%); } .ds-ring { border: .22em solid var(--coral,#ffab87); border-radius: 50%; } @media (max-width:740px) { .ds-felt { padding: 17px 20px; } .ds-board { width: min(100%,310px); } .ds-ring,.ds-cross { font-size: clamp(38px,12vw,58px); } }

components.css: .ds-score { color: var(--ink,#183d31); padding-top: 16px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line,#d4d8c8); font: 400 1rem/1.45 var(--sans,'DM Sans Variable',system-ui,sans-serif); } .ds-score h2 { margin: 0; font: 400 1.7rem/1.12 var(--serif,'DM Serif Text',Georgia,serif); letter-spacing: -.03em; } .ds-score dl { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3,1fr); margin: 12px 0 0; text-align: center; } .ds-score dl div + div { border-left: 1px solid var(--line,#d4d8c8); } .ds-score dt { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; font-size: .75rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--muted,#58675c); } .ds-score dt i { box-sizing: border-box; width: 9px; height: 9px; } .ds-score-cross { clip-path: polygon(20% 0,50% 30%,80% 0,100% 20%,70% 50%,100% 80%,80% 100%,50% 70%,20% 100%,0 80%,30% 50%,0 20%); background: #5e7936; } .ds-score-ring { border: 2px solid #a45534; border-radius: 50%; } .ds-score dt .ds-score-tie { height: 2px; background: #758071; } .ds-score dd { margin: 0; font: 650 1.85rem/1.2 var(--sans,'DM Sans Variable',system-ui,sans-serif); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; letter-spacing: -.04em; } .ds-score p { color: var(--muted,#58675c); margin: 12px 0 0; text-align: center; font-size: .74rem; }

narrative.overview:
The green felt holds the game. Cream paper carries the instructions, opponent choices and scores. A tilted four-tile monogram and a pair of illustrated game pieces identify the club before the first move.

The same cross and ring appear on the board and in its player key. A small serif heading, a thin rule and aligned digits give the scorecard the feel of a printed record.
keyCharacteristics: A pale page around a dark playing table.
Citron crosses and coral rings with written player labels.
Serif headings and compact sans-serif controls.

rules.name: Player identification
rules.body: Keep X a cross and O a ring on both felt and paper. Use a written label wherever the symbols identify the players.

dos: Do pair each player’s shape with a written name in the board key.
Do keep round controls next to the board when the columns stack.
Do respect reduced motion by disabling the mark animation.
donts: Don't use color alone to communicate a player or radio selection.
